conbody.p: You can perform the following actions with web clauses in X-Author for Contracts Advanced:

ul.li: Insert a web clause from the Clause Library

Insert a web clause and maintain formatting
X-Author for Contracts Advanced supports the following formatting:
Heading 1,2, and 3
Font style
Font size
Text color
Bold
Italics
Underline
Alignment Left, Right, and Center
Numbered list
Bullet list
Undo actions
Mark web clauses as Smart or Read Only
Add conditions to web clauses. The web clause will only be inserted if all requirements for the condition are met.
After you check-in a contract document, you can see the web clause status in Conga CLM under Clauses > Source Action.
